definition.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Georgie. Find the vocabulary, definitions and a free worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
definition.zh: I'm Neil. And I'm Georgie. Find the vocabulary, definitions and a free worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.

definition.en: I'm Georgie. And I'm Neil. Don't forget you can find vocabulary, definitions and a worksheet for free on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
definition.zh: 我是 Georgie。我是 Neil。别忘了，你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 免费获取词汇表、释义和练习题。

definitely.en: It is definitely hairy skin and Anand was spot on.
definitely.zh: It is definitely hairy skin and Anand was spot on.

describe.en: Some people describe it as a revival of British cuisine.
describe.zh: 有些人将其描述为英国菜的复兴。

describe.en: And something can be described using the adjective itchy.
describe.zh: And something can be described using the adjective itchy.

detail.en: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.
detail.zh: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.

deliberately.en: Deliberately looking for rejection might be an extreme way to become more confident, but it can lead to surprising discoveries.
deliberately.zh: 故意寻求拒绝也许是建立自信的一种极端方式，但它可能会带来令人惊喜的发现。

depend.en: Most people lived in villages and depended on the land around them.
depend.zh: 大多数人住在村庄里，依靠他们周围的土地生活。

depend.en: Britain depended on imported food at the time, but German submarines threatened all the ships crossing the Atlantic.
depend.zh: 当时英国依赖进口食物，但德国潜艇威胁了所有穿过大西洋的船只。

depend.en: When your career depends on voters believing that you are the best person to lead the country, saying that you should have done something differently is hard.
depend.zh: 当你的职业生涯取决于选民是否相信你是领导国家的最佳人选时，承认自己本该采取其他做法是很难的。

depend.en: For decades, nuclear power depended almost entirely on governments: government funding, government regulation, government risk-taking, because private investors found it too expensive and too slow.
depend.zh: 几十年来，核电几乎完全依赖政府：政府出资、政府监管、政府承担风险，因为私人投资者觉得它太昂贵、见效太慢。

design.en: But in October of last year, October 2025, Italy's government approved a new bill to bring nuclear power back: small modular reactors , new-generation designs, and even fusion.
design.zh: 但在去年10月，即2025年10月，意大利政府批准了一项重新引入核电的新法案：小型模块化反应堆、新一代设计，甚至还包括核聚变。

demand.en: Factory work involved long hours of physically demanding labor.
demand.zh: 工厂工作涉及长时间的体力消耗劳动。

demand.en: And with billions of people using AI, well, you get a level of electricity demand that didn't really exist five years ago.
demand.zh: 随着数十亿人使用人工智能，便催生了五年前根本不存在的巨大用电需求。

demand.en: To put it in real terms, Goldman Sachs now projects that electricity demand from data centres will grow by 160% by 2030, driven largely by AI.
demand.zh: 具体来说，高盛目前预计，在人工智能的极大推动下，到2030年，数据中心的用电需求将增长160%。

decade.en: This one ran safely for decades, and only closed in 2019, for ordinary financial reasons.
decade.zh: 这一座反应堆安全运行了数十年，直到2019年才出于普通的财务原因关闭。

decade.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
decade.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

decade.en: In any case, never before has so much private money been committed to nuclear energy, and we are only six years into the decade.
decade.zh: 无论如何，历史上从未有如此多的私人资金投入到核能领域，而这个十年才刚刚过去六年。

despite.en: They've been around for decades, and despite what the fear mongering might have you believe, most of what they do has nothing to do with artificial intelligence.
despite.zh: 它们已经存在了几十年，尽管某些耸人听闻的言论可能会让你胡思乱想，但它们的大部分工作与人工智能毫无关系。

despite.en: The first is that big technology companies are still investing in nuclear energy despite these frequent cost overruns , which gives you some idea of just how desperate they are for power.
despite.zh: 第一，尽管成本超支频发，大型科技公司仍在投资核能，这足以说明它们对电力有多么渴望。

deal.en: Microsoft has signed a deal to buy fusion electricity from a company called Helion by 2028.
deal.zh: 微软已经与一家名为 Helion 的公司签署了一项协议，到2028年购买核聚变电力。

deal.en: Microsoft, for example, signed a deal back in 2024 to bring one of the two reactors at Three Mile Island, in Pennsylvania, back to life.
deal.zh: 例如，微软在2024年签署了一项协议，让宾夕法尼亚州三哩岛的两座反应堆之一重获新生。

decision.en: Critics point out that decisions made about something as safety-critical as nuclear power are increasingly being made by companies whose main interest is keeping their data centres running, not public accountability .
decision.zh: 批评人士指出，像核电这样攸关安全的重大决策，正日益由那些主要利益是维持数据中心运行、而非对公众负责的公司来制定。

desperate.en: The first is that big technology companies are still investing in nuclear energy despite these frequent cost overruns , which gives you some idea of just how desperate they are for power.
desperate.zh: 第一，尽管成本超支频发，大型科技公司仍在投资核能，这足以说明它们对电力有多么渴望。

demonstrate.en: And French elites, French aristocrats, used food as a way of demonstrating their sophistication , their superiority.
demonstrate.zh: 法国精英和法国贵族将食物作为展示其复杂性和优越性的一种方式。

dessert.en: Spices appear in traditional British recipes for meat, desserts, sauces, baked goods, and drinks.
dessert.zh: 香料出现在肉类、甜点、酱汁、烘焙食品和饮料的传统英国食谱中。

dessert.en: A well-made sticky toffee pudding is perhaps the best dessert in the world, in my opinion.
dessert.zh: 在我看来，一个制作精良的太妃糖布丁也许是世界上最好的甜点。

deserve.en: But what do you think? Does British food deserve its bad reputation?
deserve.zh: 不过你是怎么想的呢？英国食物配得上它的恶名吗？

deserve.en: But Britain doesn’t necessarily deserve its negative reputation.
deserve.zh: 但英国也未必就该背负这样的恶名。
